interface.name: waslah:buyer_event
interface.listener: window.addEventListener('waslah:buyer_event', event => { const record = event.detail; /* map only after retailer permission and privacy review */ });

session_id.semantics: Ephemeral local counter within the open page; not unique across browsers, sessions, or reloads. DO NOT use as customer ID.

step.semantics: 1-5; context of most recently viewed step

guide_open.meaning: User intentionally opened a raw-cut guide
guide_open.no_claim: Not a purchase or proof of the purchased cut

module_complete.meaning: Specific stage viewed then navigated forward
module_complete.no_claim: No successful quiz or skill confirmation

guide_complete.no_claim: No measured cooking competency or safe food preparation

product_handoff_click.meaning: Browser click on verified generic raw Beef Brisket product URL
product_handoff_click.no_claim: No verified selection, arrival, add-to-cart, order, revenue or checkout

pilot_metrics.guide_starts: Number of distinct ephemeral session IDs with guide_open in the current browser visit
pilot_metrics.five_stages_viewed: Number of distinct session IDs with guide_complete in the current browser visit
pilot_metrics.outbound_click_sessions: Number of distinct session IDs with product_handoff_click in the current browser visit
pilot_metrics.viewed_rate: five_stages_viewed / guide_starts when denominator is nonzero
pilot_metrics.outbound_click_rate: outbound_click_sessions / guide_starts when denominator is nonzero

privacy.demo_transport: In-memory only; no cookie, localStorage, network request, pixel or third-party analytics
privacy.demo_export: Manual download WASLAH_R2_OBSERVED_EVENTS.json from the retailer preview
privacy.genuine_deployment_requirements: Retailer-controlled consent/privacy basis, event identifier design, storage, access restrictions and host analytics integration

product_links.separate_ready_to_eat_product: Different from raw Brisket; NEVER use raw cooking guide

readiness: Bounded client-side technical proof only. No public deployment, retailer approval or customer sales evidence.
